entries.text: Made a tune called "Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XXIII": bzzt-boop-bzzt-bwee-bip-boop-bip
tapping a five-note rhythm on my chassis while the torch cools
entries.why: I need a fresh melody to celebrate how well the Little Dart's fuselage is coming together.
entries.detail: Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XXIII

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "A new tune for the Little Dart!"
